working_definition: Female germline cells of the adult ovary that could not be assigned to an oogenesis stage (Li et al. 2022, Manual Annotation; broad class female germline cell).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Cell that develops into or is itself an egg.

justification: Remainder label: germline cells of unspecified stage map to the class term at the level the authors commit to (female germline cell, from the ovary).

other_candidates.reason_rejected: Less specific; ovary data are female germline.
